description: Search dinogame.gg's catalogue of free, no-install browser games (Tetris, 2048, Snake, chess, solitaire, Wordle-likes and dozens more). Returns each game's title, a short description, its controls, category, and a dinogame.gg URL to play it. Use when a user wants a game to play, a recommendation, or a specific type of browser game.

category.description: Optional game-category slug to filter by (see list_game_categories).

name: search_games
